advisoryExceptions.reason: GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c (npm advisory 1241202) covers every release of sprintf-js, so no release fixes it. kit pulls sprintf-js 1.0.3 in only through @microsoft/api-extractor -> @rushstack/ts-command-line -> argparse 1.0.10 -> sprintf-js, which formats the help and error texts of the api-extractor command with its own format strings; make lint-ts runs that command with fixed arguments only, and no input of a user reaches sprintf-js
advisoryExceptions.removalCondition: a release of sprintf-js fixes GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c, or @microsoft/api-extractor no longer depends on argparse; make dependency-review then reports the exception as stale
